text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm taking a break in the

cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Acute! Listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I got a request to go on a TV show! It's a
talk
show, and the topic is feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, Rickey! That's wonderful to
hear.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The world is making way for feng shui! If
this goes
well, I'll be able to spread its
wondrous teachings
to even more
people!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! Since I'm going to be talking
on TV, I
need to compile some
discussion topics! I have to
make it easy
for beginners to understand too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Then, when I finish putting
together my
talking points, will you
listen to what I've come up
with? I want
you to tell me if there's anything you

don't understand!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you just knock their socks right off,
Rickey.
In fact, I think I might whip up
some ohagi to
keep you going.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yay! I love your ohagi, Acute! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ And I'll make sure to come and
see you
in all your glory when you're
doing your talk
show.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Hello there! ♪ Miracles come to those
who
believe! It's time for our segment on
the spiritual
fates of feng shui! And our
guest for today is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Helloooo! My
name's Copano
Rickey! I'm here to tell
you all about feng shui so
we can all be
happy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Your spiritual aura is even
stronger in
person! I can just feel the
good fortune emanating
from you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I are watching from
the
audience. It might just be me, but I
feel like this
host is using some rather
shady words...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Hm. We've had a question from someone
asking
how to meet their soulmate. This
person should
wear something pink! If I
remember correctly...
that boosts your
luck in love, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! The feng shui of colors is deeply

connected to the five elements! And the
five
elements are—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry! We're tight on time, so
let's keep it
moving. Next question!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The feng shui you should follow for
arranging
your home can vary depending
on your house!
Using this compass can
help you find a more
accurate way to
utilize feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you pour your holy
power into
that device and
then—BAM—a miracle happens!
Whoa,
how convenient!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... It looks a bit like Rickey is
struggling
to get her voice heard. Just
look at her little ears
drooping.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're quite right.
You can do it, Rickey.
We're rooting for you,
dearie.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(It's Trainer and Acute... That's right—I
came here
to tell everyone about feng
shui! I'm not backing
down now!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um! If it's okay with you... Shall we play
feng shui
true or false? All the questions
are
straightforward so I think people can
learn some
useful tips!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Yes, good idea! I'm sure the
audience would
enjoy that!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Here we go. It's better to carry plenty of
lucky
items around with you. True or
false?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The answer is "false"! Going overboard
can have
the opposite effect! ☆ Okay,
next: Things like
good and bad
directions and lucky colors change

depending on the year and location.
True or
false?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so the answer's true! Hey, this quiz is
pretty
fun. I can answer with just a "true"
or "false," so
it's not as intimidating!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Feng shui is more down-to-earth
than I
thought. It's got a solid
foundation and it actually
seems really
deep...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you did just wonderfully, Rickey.
The
audience had such a smashing time.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's great to hear! I saw you two
cheering for
me too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's great to hear! I saw you two
cheering for
me too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's thanks to the courage you two
gave me! I'm
still a little sad that I didn't
get to talk in much
depth...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I did get to introduce some feng shui
basics
with that quiz, so it was definitely
a success!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh Rickey, you did so, so well. And I
just know
that all your efforts will bear
fruit one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute embraces Copano Rickey
and
gently strokes her back as if to
soothe her.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks! I hope you'll both help
me out next
time, too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm not stopping here!
Tomorrow, the
next day, and the day
after that—every single
day—I'm going
to do my best to make everyone

happier!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, dearie. Knock all their
socks off.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I will! And it's not just the show's
audience who
enjoyed it—everyone's
talking about it on
Umatter too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
People are saying they understand feng
shui a
little better now, and that they
want another true
or false quiz!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, that just goes to show that you're
getting
somewhere, doesn't it? You've
worked so very
hard after all, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute gives Copano Rickey a
pat on the
head.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
True! Buuuut, I have to make sure I learn
from my
mistakes!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think trying to explain all of it at once
was
probably kind of overwhelming, so I
need to
make things a little simpler!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Explanation 2.0! I'm
going to
do eeeven better next time!
